# Landscale

> Landscale builds AI quoting assistants, AI receptionists, plan & tender review tools and websites for trade, construction and service businesses. The goal is to take the slow, repetitive part of quoting, phone calls and admin off a business's desk, while people keep making the decisions. Most clients are in Hungary, with clients in Austria and the United Kingdom.

Founder: Milán Pirint. Contact: milan@landscale.net | +36 70 250 1739. Website: https://landscale.agency (Hungarian: https://landscale.agency/hu)
Registered business: Pirint Frigyes E.V. (Hungarian sole trader), tax no. 91678270-1-35.

---

## Services

- [AI Quoting Assistant](https://landscale.agency/services/ai-estimator): A chat assistant on a business's website that asks the questions the owner would ask (job type, size, materials, location, timeline) and gives an itemised estimate on the spot, 24/7, built on the business's own prices. Contact details are collected after the estimate, so enquiries come from people who already know the price. Live on four client sites (NM Bau, Kazán Szerviz Kecskemét, Kecskemét Klíma, Aqua System).
- [Plan & Tender Review](https://landscale.agency/services/tender-review): Two tools for contractors and manufacturers who price from drawings and tender packages. Plan Reader (Tervolvasó) reads architectural, structural and MEP drawings, measures quantities and compares them line by line with the designer's bill of quantities, showing the source sheet, calculation and confidence for every number. Tender Prep (Ajánlat-előkészítő) cross-checks drawings, data sheets and item lists, ranks likely errors and missing data, drafts clarifying questions, splits items by workshop or supplier and builds a first price draft. Output is an Excel workbook. A person always reviews and approves the result.
- [AI Receptionist](https://landscale.agency/services/ai-receptionist): A voice assistant that answers a business's phone, looks up order status in the CRM, answers routine questions, takes new enquiries, hands over to a person when needed, and logs every call back into the CRM.
- [Quote Builder for Garages](https://landscale.agency/services/mechanic-quoting): Itemised repair quotes from a VIN, using the garage's own brands, parts prices and labour rate.
- [Website Design](https://landscale.agency/services/website-design): Bespoke, fast websites with local SEO built in, and the quoting assistant integrated where needed.
- [AI Chatbot](https://landscale.agency/services/ai-chatbot) and [Local SEO](https://landscale.agency/services/seo-marketing) are also available.

## Case Studies

Nine live projects: https://landscale.agency/case-studies

- NM Bau (Sopron, bathroom and full renovation): trilingual website with a live AI quoting assistant.
- Álomfürdő (Sopron): bathroom-products webshop for NM Bau, a returning client.
- Aqua System (Érd, heating, water and gas): website, AI quoting assistant and automatic review collection.
- Kazán Szerviz Kecskemét and Kecskemét Klíma (Kecskemét): two websites with AI quoting for the same owner.
- Tiszaújváros Transz (construction), ViszCAD (engineering office), Lavotha Kert Kft and Mimosa Gardens (landscaping): websites.

---

## About

Milán Pirint is the founder of Landscale. Artificial intelligence has fascinated him for a long time, and he focuses it on one problem: the hours businesses lose to quoting, phone calls and admin. Every tool is set up around the client's own jobs, prices and process, and clients deal with the founder directly from the first call through launch and support.

Full about page: https://landscale.agency/about
